//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Piglin Names -> Config

Enable Piglin Names.//: Whether Piglin Names is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

useCustomNames.//: Use the custom name list, editable in ./mods/piglinnames/customnames.txt, seperated by a comma. If custom names are found, the default name list is ignored.

useDefaultFemaleNames.//: Use the list of pre-defined female names when naming piglins.

useDefaultMaleNames.//: Use the list of pre-defined male names when naming piglins.

useBothCustomAndDefaultNames.//: Disabled by default. Whether both custom and default names should be used to name piglins.

shouldCapitalizeNames.//: If enabled, the mod capitalizes each word in the custom name list.
